title: scrophularia canina subsp. ramosissima
intro: Scrophularia canina subsp. ramosissima, commonly known as the lesser figwort, is a plant species in the figwort family that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are said to help reduce stress and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Scrophularia canina subsp. ramosissima are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
